subject.title: WhatsApp 1:1: inbound image wedges main lane ~3min before processing — multimodal run strands active_reply_work/queued_work_without_active_run (repro on 2026.6.10, post-#95039)

question: Should #96834 remain a separate WhatsApp live-repro tracker until #102160/#101910 land, or be folded immediately into #97538 and the run-lifecycle stack?
rationale: The remaining fix direction changes recovery ownership and stale active-reply policy, and the issue now spans multiple WhatsApp trigger shapes that may need explicit live validation after the lifecycle stack lands.

options.title: Keep As WhatsApp Tracker
options.body: Keep #96834 open and use it to verify DM image burst, text-only direct, and group-lane behavior after #102160/#101910 land or are revised.

options.title: Fold Under #97538
options.body: Close or consolidate #96834 under the broader #97538 lane/replay cluster now, accepting that WhatsApp-specific repro details move to the canonical issue or PR validation checklist.

options.title: Split By Failure Mode
options.body: Split active_reply_work registry leak, command-queue generation strand, and durable replay storm into separate maintainer-owned trackers before deciding what each open PR must prove.

recommendation.title: Keep As WhatsApp Tracker
recommendation.body: Keep #96834 open and use it to verify DM image burst, text-only direct, and group-lane behavior after #102160/#101910 land or are revised.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the active open lifecycle stack that is most likely to decide and implement the terminal-release/stale-takeover policy.
